name: GhostDialogContent
description: Headless dialog surface for GhostDialog. Composes GhostPortal, useScrollLock, useInertOthers, useDismissableLayer, and useFocusScope while staying unmounted when closed.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the dialog surface.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Dismisses the topmost open dialog on `Escape`.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Dismisses the dialog on outside pointerdown (`true` for `'dialog'`, `false` for `'alertdialog'` by default).

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport content through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

props.name: role
props.description: Semantic ARIA role for the dialog surface (`'dialog'` or `'alertdialog'`).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Dialog heading, description, body content, and action controls rendered while open.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the dialog surface element.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Resolved dialog surface element while open; null when closed or unmounted.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the dialog surface element when mounted.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Dialog surface marked with class ghost-dialog-content and data-part="content".

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while mounted and open.

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open dialog when closeOnEscape is true.
keyboard.Tab: Cycles forward within modal dialogs; moves freely in non-modal dialogs.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Cycles backward within modal dialogs; moves freely in non-modal dialogs.
